      "observations": [
        "The entire 36-path historical diff was read. MimeClosure carries an enum tag plus raw pointer by value, copies both and defines an explicit boolean conversion based only on pointer presence. Callback typedefs, decoder initializers, parse/decode/crypto callbacks and their producers now pass that wrapper without incompatible function-pointer casts. Draft/display stream closures use their specific tags; dummy_file_write now receives draft data and reaches its tmpFileStream. mime_ReBuffer declaration/implementation are removed and the new header is exported. No test changed.",
        "The common Bug 1919290 context explains UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer runtime reports about invalid function-pointer/type operations after Bug 1852662 and rejects merely erasing typed callback parameters to void*. It proposes a lightweight tag wrapper without per-closure allocation. The available description/comments 0–30 and updates were read. Later comments explain that the fourth patch shortens earlier checks, list merge dependencies, defer ESR uplift while related regressions are investigated and require Bug 1927290 with the backport. User-impact and risk statements in approval comments are not test executions.",
        "D222475 reports an earlier test regression from aborting processing too strictly; the revision now skips only work depending on missing objects, then the author reports a satisfactory Try and fixes a missed XP_MACOSX site. mkmelin explicitly accepts but states limited deeper understanding. Of six actual submitted inlines, enum-zero clarification 1243833/1244192 is Done; BenC automatic constructors 1243868 and private checked accessors 1243861 remain Not Done. The author defers both proposals and explains that explicit manual tags let compiler errors locate every conversion site. Do not copy the proposed accessor snippets as accepted implementations.",
        "Fixed source centralizes checked conversions in AsMime... methods, with debug assertions and nullptr for mismatched tags; this is the later 934 refinement, not the initial 931 implementation. The boolean conversion still validates neither tag nor ownership. Existing draft cleanup frees the underlying data separately, and the decoder header permits a final callback when abort_p=false, so the pointee must survive normal flush/destruction. The supported draft alternative is tested before a display-only conversion; current UI-sink lookup also excludes header=filter/attach. No sanitizer, build, callback lifetime or cryptographic operation ran. Six focused existing claims are reused."
